Definition: from G4862 and G5271; to act hypocritically in concert with:--dissemble with.
BiblicalUsage: The other Jews dissemble likewise with Peter, playing a part with him, insomuch that Barnabas also is carried away with their dissimulation. The dissembling is done in concert, a whole company acting a part together, and the acting is catching: even Barnabas is carried away by a performance he knows is false.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that hypocrisy acted in concert is catching, and I believe I must not play a part with the crowd, even when the crowd includes Peter and Barnabas.
